objective: Produce a packaged Node 26 SPARC64 build that installs cleanly, runs representative applications on T7 and T4, and has documented build requirements and limitations.
acceptance: Fresh source checkout restored from authenticated base and overlay, with no copied generated files, build objects or Rust archives; documented native build succeeds
Versioned binary and source archives, complete port patch and SHA-256 checksums are produced with source/build/runtime provenance
Package installs and relocates in isolated prefixes; installed node, npm and npx and a native addon build work without using development-tree executables or headers
The same package passes representative HTTP/HTTPS/WebSocket, worker, TypeScript, Temporal, Wasm and FFI applications on T7 and T4, with native optimizing execution and CPU/ABI checks
Bounded installed-application soak and performance/memory baselines are recorded on both machines
Build/runtime requirements, install/uninstall instructions, supported hardware and known fixture/feature limitations are documented; package contents and evidence verified locally and natively
The validated parent checkpoint and worktree remain unchanged; no upstream publication without review
runtime_strategy: Shared OpenSSL 3, ICU 78, glibc and GCC runtime; explicit ABI requirements, validated on both machines
